fontFamily: Source Han Sans SC VF, Source Han Sans SC, sans-serif

themeVariables.fontFamily: Source Han Sans SC VF, Source Han Sans SC, sans-serif

themeCSS: .node rect, .node polygon, .node path { stroke-width: 1.6px; } .node rect { rx: 10px; ry: 10px; } .cluster rect { rx: 12px; ry: 12px; stroke-width: 1.4px; } .nodeLabel, .edgeLabel, .label, text { font-family: 'Source Han Sans SC VF', 'Source Han Sans SC', sans-serif !important; } .nodeLabel p, .edgeLabel p { line-height: 1.42; margin: 0; } .edgeLabel rect, .labelBkg { fill: #ffffff !important; opacity: 0.96 !important; rx: 5px; ry: 5px; } .flowchart-link { stroke-width: 1.7px; } marker path { fill: #617383 !important; stroke: #617383 !important; } .cluster-label text, .cluster-label span { font-weight: 650 !important; color: #294B60 !important; }
